questions.question: Akua is in charge of supervising the entire process of getting products into the marketplace, otherwise known as the flow of goods. Akua's job title is most likely
questions.explanation: Supply chain manager. A supply chain manager is in charge of supervising the entire process of getting goods into the marketplace, including coordinating with other companies and vendors. A line supervisor supervises a given team, or line, to ensure quality and productivity. A chief financial officer, or CFO, monitors all of a company's funds and assets. An inventory manager supervises and controls the number of finished products a company has in stock.
questions.source: Hayes, A. (2020, July 1). Supply chain management (SCM). Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.investopedia.com/terms/s/scm.asp

performanceIndicator.text: Explain the concept of supply chain

questions.question: The use of technology in supply chain management often results in
questions.explanation: Increased efficiency. By reducing human error and improving overall performance, the use of technology in supply chain management often results in increased efficiency. The use of technology in supply chain management does not necessarily result in improved budgeting. Technology generally increases efficiency and reduces human error.
questions.source: Dupre Logistics. (2018, November 5). The impact of technology on supply chain management. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://duprelogistics.com/in-the-news/the-impact-of-technology-on-supply-chain-management

performanceIndicator.text: Describe the impact of technology on supply chain management

questions.question: Supply chain networks are often
questions.explanation: Redesigned. Factors such as changing laws, new companies, companies going out of business, and material availability can cause companies to redesign their supply chain networks often. Supply chain networks should not be eliminated because they are not unimportant. A properly designed supply chain network should help a company become more profitable.
questions.source: River Logic. (2019, November 26). Supply chain network optimization: What you need to be successful. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.riverlogic.com/blog/supply-chain-network-optimization-what-you-need-to-be-successful

performanceIndicator.text: Describe supply chain networks

questions.question: One possible downside to choosing overseas suppliers is
questions.explanation: Increased delivery times. Most companies want to reduce supply chain costs. Some of them may decide to use overseas suppliers, who often have lower prices and lower taxes. However, using an overseas supplier can often result in increased delivery time and a more complex supply chain.
questions.source: Roy, E. (2017, March 31). What are the biggest challenges of managing global supply chains? Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.tradeready.ca/2017/topics/supply-chain-management/biggest-challenges-managing-global-supply-chains/

performanceIndicator.text: Discuss global supply chain issues

questions.question: How can a company hold employees accountable for protecting digital assets?
questions.explanation: An effective laptop security policy. Employees should be held accountable for the digital assets housed on their computers. One way to achieve this is by requiring employees to sign a detailed and effective laptop security policy that provides employees with best practices to ensure laptop security. Encryption software is more likely to protect digital assets from outsiders and/or criminals rather than holding employees accountable. Project management software is not necessarily related to protecting digital assets. Background checks will not necessarily help hold employees accountable for protecting digital assets.
questions.source: WinEncrypt. (n.d.). Protecting digital assets in the modern organization. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.winencrypt.com/downloads/resources/whitepapers/WinEncrypt_protecting_digital_assets.pdf

performanceIndicator.text: Comply with strategies for protecting business' digital assets (e.g., website, social media, email, etc.)

questions.question: As a specific outcome you intend to work toward, a goal is a(n)
questions.explanation: Target. As a specific outcome you intend to work toward, a goal is a target—something you aim for. A goal is not a skill, though you may learn skills so you can reach your goal. A goal is not a performance, though you may perform certain actions to reach your goal. And, a goal is not an evaluation, though you may receive an evaluation on your performance if your goal is a performance goal.
questions.source: LAP-PD-016—Go for the Goal (Goal Setting)

performanceIndicator.text: Set personal goals

questions.question: Employees who have supervisory responsibilities for part or all of the business work in
questions.explanation: General management. Employees who have supervisory responsibility for part or all of the business work in general management. Careers in general management focus on planning, organizing, directing, and evaluating part or all of a business organization through the allocation and use of financial, human, and material resources. These employees do not work in business information management, securities and investments, or merchandising. Business information management employees help align business and IT goals. The securities and investments industry consists of brokerage firms, investment banks, and stock exchanges, all of which support the flow of funds from investors to companies and institutions. Merchandising careers involve marketing activities that are focused on efficient and effective product planning, selection, and buying for resale.
questions.source: LAP-PD-025—Go for It! (Careers in Business)

performanceIndicator.text: Explain employment opportunities in business

questions.question: Human resources management, operations management, and administrative services are all employment opportunities within
questions.explanation: Business management and administration. Human resources management, operations management, and administrative services are all subcategories within the cluster of business management and administration. Financial and banking services management, human affairs and counseling services, and secretarial and managerial services are not usually considered career clusters.
questions.source: Washington Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction. (n.d.). Business, management, and administration. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.k12.wa.us/student-success/career-technical-education/career-technical-education-pathways/business-management-and-administration

performanceIndicator.text: Discuss employment opportunities in business management and administration

questions.question: Employers promote employees who have shown that they are reliable, trustworthy, and
questions.explanation: Competent. Employers want to promote employees who are willing to accept more responsibility, authority, and challenges. Employers tend to promote employees who have proven that they are reliable, trustworthy, and competent. A dependable employee consistently completes work on time. A trustworthy employee is honest and transparent. A competent employee demonstrates that s/he is capable of performing the necessary activities to complete the work. Employers tend to promote employees who are interdependent rather than dependent (needy). Employers may promote interesting employees, but it is not the most important quality for the employee to possess. Employers also promote assertive, rather than aggressive employees, because assertive employees respect their own rights as well as the rights of others. Aggressive people do not respect the rights of others.
questions.source: Guthrie, S. (2014, May 26). Advisor: Eight traits that get you promoted. Retrieved September 1, 2020, from https://thenewdaily.com.au/finance/work/2014/05/26/top-10-personality-traits-will-get-promoted/

performanceIndicator.text: Identify skills needed to enhance career progression

questions.question: Social media policies are especially important in today's modern world because

options.A: the Internet can only harm a company's reputation.
options.B: employees can't be trusted with technology.
options.C: negative comments can spread quickly online.
options.D: companies rely on social media to communicate.

questions.explanation: Negative comments can spread quickly online. Social media policies are especially important in today's ultra-connected world. One negative comment about a company on social media can spread like wildfire—harming the reputation of both the person who posted it and the company. It is not true that employees can't be trusted with technology—many companies rely on employees' use of technology to complete their work effectively and efficiently. While it is true that the Internet can potentially harm a company's reputation, it can also be a useful tool for improving a company's reputation and for spreading awareness of the company's products or services. Companies do not generally rely solely on social media to communicate.
questions.source: LAP-PD-250—Do You Follow? (Adhering to Company Protocols and Policies)

performanceIndicator.text: Adhere to company protocols and policies

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the chain of command is true:

options.A: It's okay to ask for help from someone below you in the chain of command, rather than asking your boss.
options.B: You should always report to the person with the most expertise on the topic you need help with.
options.C: If you know your boss can’t help you with something, you shouldn’t bother asking him/her.
options.D: It’s typically inappropriate to report to anyone else in the chain of command besides your direct supervisor.

questions.explanation: It’s typically inappropriate to report to anyone else in the chain of command besides your direct supervisor. There may be times when you feel like your boss isn’t the best person to help you with a certain question or task. But even in situations like this, it’s still best to ask your supervisor for guidance before going to someone else—even if s/he has more expertise or is below you in the chain of command. Most often, your boss will direct you to a more appropriate person if s/he truly cannot help you.
questions.source: LAP-PD-252—Don't Cheat the Chain (Following Chain of Command)

performanceIndicator.text: Follow chain of command

questions.question: When Deidra was developing the statement of work (SOW) for a complex construction project, she included a statement that describes the things that the project will and won't include. This statement is defining the project
questions.explanation: Scope. The statement of work (SOW) is a document that outlines the terms, commitments, and conditions of the project. It includes information about the project's activities, timelines, and deliverables. The scope statement is a component of the SOW that clearly defines the things that the project will do, as well as the things it won't do. The scope statement clarifies the boundaries of the project. The outcomes, risks, and constraints are issues discussed in other components of the SOW.
questions.source: Monnappa, A. (2020, April 3). What is project scope management and why it's important. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.simplilearn.com/project-scope-management-importance-rar89-article

performanceIndicator.text: Initiate project

questions.question: Which of the following is a true statement about the work breakdown structure (WBS) in project management:

options.A: The project manager should require team members to approve the WBS.
options.B: The project scope remains the same after making changes to the WBS.
options.C: Each work package should take between eight and 80 hours to complete.
options.D: Team members develop the WBS dictionary after they carry out their work tasks.

questions.explanation: Each work package should take between eight and 80 hours to complete. The 8/80 rule for dividing project work packages states that no package should take less than eight hours or more than 80 hours to complete. This rule intends to keep work packages in manageable units—not too small or too large. Making changes to the WBS changes the project scope. The project manager may get input from others when developing the WBS, but s/he does not need to get team members' approval. A WBS dictionary is a tool that helps inform project team members about the scope, status, milestones, and deliverables associated with each project activity. Team members do not develop the WBS dictionary after they carry out their work tasks.
questions.source: Mathis, M. (2020). Work breakdown structure: Purpose, process, and pitfalls. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.projectsmart.co.uk/work-breakdown-structure-purpose-process-pitfalls.html

performanceIndicator.text: Prepare work breakdown structure (WBS)

questions.question: When executing a project, the project manager must often
questions.explanation: Update the project plan. During the execution phase of the project, project team members carry out project tasks. During that time, the project manager is highly involved in controlling activities, such as monitoring the work effort. While monitoring the work effort, the project manager may detect problems. Sometimes, processes, tasks, and budgets need to be changed or corrected. Therefore, the project manager may need to update the project plan, when changes occur. The project manager develops the project charter during the initiation phase and if necessary, forms a steering committee during the project-definition phase. The project's sponsors (stakeholders) would determine changes to their requirements and advise the project manager to implement the revisions.
questions.source: Weedmark, D. (2019, August 23). Why a project plan is important. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://bizfluent.com/about-6404005-project-plan-important.html

performanceIndicator.text: Execute and control projects

questions.question: What should project managers do to ensure that team members will perform their designated tasks efficiently?

options.A: Correct the team members' mistakes for them
options.B: Ask team members if they like their assignments
options.C: Communicate their roles and responsibilities to them

questions.explanation: Communicate their roles and responsibilities to them. An important aspect of the project manager's role is to communicate to team members their individual roles and responsibilities for executing the project. When team members understand what is expected of them, the project is more likely to run smoothly and achieve its goals. Providing evaluation forms, asking team members if they like their assignments, and correcting team members' mistakes for them will not help the team members perform their work efficiently.
questions.source: Project Perfect. (2020, July 17). Managing project team members. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.projectperfect.com.au/info_managing_project_team_members.php

performanceIndicator.text: Manage project team

questions.question: Which of the following pieces of information are included in the “lessons-learned” document when closing a project:

options.A: Statement of work, successes, and failures
options.B: Costs, suggestions for improvement, and project charter
options.C: Successes, failures, and suggestions for improvement

questions.explanation: Successes, failures, and suggestions for improvement. During the project's closing phase, the project manager, team, and stakeholders provide feedback for a “lessons-learned” document. The “lessons-learned” document summarizes the project's successes and failures. The document also includes suggestions for improvement for similar projects in the future. Costs may be an issue addressed in the successes, failures, or suggestions for improvement areas of the document. Project managers develop the project charter and the statement of work during the initiation or beginning phase of the project.
questions.source: Project Management Docs. (n.d.). Lessons learned. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.projectmanagementdocs.com/project-closing-templates/lessons-learned.html#axzz4eFPJgKvT

performanceIndicator.text: Close project

questions.question: An organization-wide system that businesses use to ensure that products meet quality standards is known as quality
questions.explanation: Assurance. Quality management is the ongoing process of planning, implementing, and integrating quality into every aspect of an organization. There are three main aspects of quality management—quality control, quality assurance, and quality improvement. Quality control is a process that measures products against predetermined standards after the products have already been created. Quality improvement involves an organization's willingness to change and adapt for the purpose of maintaining quality. Finally, quality assurance is an organization-wide system that businesses use to ensure that products meet quality standards.
questions.source: LAP-QM-001—Keep It Quality (Nature of Quality Management)

performanceIndicator.text: Explain the nature of quality management

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about the Six Sigma quality management framework:

options.A: It can be effective without establishing incremental benchmarks.
options.B: It focuses on increasing employee job satisfaction.
options.C: It emphasizes lowering costs more than improving quality.
options.D: It involves change throughout the entire organization.

questions.explanation: It involves change throughout the entire organization. Six Sigma is an internationally recognized quality management framework that was developed by Motorola. Six Sigma focuses on continuously improving quality throughout an organization while lowering its costs at the same time. An important aspect of using the Six Sigma framework is continuously setting incremental goals and measuring their success against the established benchmarks. To implement and execute Six Sigma successfully, improvement efforts should involve input and action from employees at all levels of the organization. When all employees are involved in the process, they often feel as if they have control over their work, which can increase personal job-satisfaction levels.
questions.source: Kumar, P. (2020, July 7). What is six sigma: A complete overview. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.simplilearn.com/what-is-six-sigma-a-complete-overview-article

performanceIndicator.text: Describe the nature of quality management frameworks (e.g., Six Sigma, ITIL, CMMI)

questions.question: How do ethics relate to risk management?

options.A: The best form of business ethics is risk management.
options.B: Risk management is all about the ethical treatment of customers.
options.C: Risk management is insurance for lapses in business ethics.
options.D: The best form of risk management is adherence to business ethics.

questions.explanation: The best form of risk management is adherence to business ethics. Every breach of business ethics represents a potential risk for businesses. The best thing businesses can do to overcome most risks is to do the right thing—practice business ethics. Risk management includes the ethical treatment of customers as well as a variety of other factors. Insurance is one way to overcome business risks; however, risk management is much more than insurance.
questions.source: Disparte, D. (2016, November 8). Simple ethics rules for better risk management. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://hbr.org/2016/11/simple-ethics-rules-for-better-risk-management

performanceIndicator.text: Explain the role of ethics in risk management

questions.question: Using appropriate software to protect confidential data that are stored on a company's computer systems is an important part of managing
questions.explanation: Security risks. Risk management is a business activity that involves planning, controlling, preventing, and establishing procedures to limit business losses. Businesses use technology to minimize security risks. One way that businesses control security risks is by installing firewalls on computer networks to prevent computer hackers from obtaining confidential financial data (e.g., customers' credit card numbers). Natural disasters include occurrences such as hurricanes, tornadoes, and floods. Physical safety risks involve threats to a person's well-being and may include environmental hazards such as air pollution and water toxins.
questions.source: Smith, D. (2019, May 8). Managing security risks in the cloud. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://blog.radware.com/security/cloudsecurity/2019/05/managing-security-risks-in-the-cloud/

performanceIndicator.text: Describe the use of technology in risk management

questions.question: Which of the following is the type of action that a business is taking when it continuously monitors the laws that affect its operations for the purpose of minimizing risk:
questions.explanation: Preventative. Businesses must comply with a variety of government regulations. Because regulations often change, it is important for businesses to keep up with changes so they can implement appropriate action, if needed, to stay in compliance. Monitoring regulations is a preventative action because it is taking steps to prevent the negative consequences associated with noncompliance. If a business does not comply with regulations, it can be fined, or in some situations, closed down. In addition, noncompliance may result in a poor public image that lowers the business's credibility with its customers. Corrective, reactive, and remedial actions are taken after issues or problems are identified.
questions.source: Old Dominion University. (2019, October 15). What is internal control? Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.odu.edu/about/compliance/internal-auditing/internal-controls#:~:text=Detective%20controls%20are%20designed%20to,occurring%20in%20the%20first%20place.

performanceIndicator.text: Discuss legal considerations affecting risk management

questions.question: Which of the following questions should effective managerial planning answer:

options.A: How will we monitor the work effort?
options.D: What do we want to do?

questions.explanation: What do we want to do? The management function of deciding what will be done and how it will be accomplished is planning. A primary aspect of the planning function is determining the goals or desired outcomes—determining what we want to do. All activities carried out in the other functions of management—organizing, staffing, controlling, and directing—depend on the answer(s) to the question, "What do we want to do?" Deciding who will do the work is a staffing activity. Measuring the success or achievement of goals is a controlling activity. Determining how to monitor the work effort is a directing activity.
questions.source: Juneja, P. (2020). Functions of management. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.managementstudyguide.com/management_functions.htm

performanceIndicator.text: Discuss the nature of managerial planning

questions.question: Success Unlimited Corporation has a detailed structure that determines job roles. Therefore, all employees know exactly what they are supposed to be doing and feel confident and satisfied in their positions. This is an example of how

options.B: it is important to know who is in charge.
options.C: managerial organization leads to a sense of security.
options.D: companies that grow quickly are more organized.

questions.explanation: Managerial organization leads to a sense of security. When a company is well organized, everyone has a clear idea about his/her job positions. They know exactly what they are supposed to do, which leads to confidence, security, and satisfaction. This example does not demonstrate the importance of knowing who is in charge. It is also not an example of how organizational structure leads to cooperation or how companies that grow quickly are more organized.
questions.source: Juneja, P. (2020). Importance of organizing function. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.managementstudyguide.com/organizing_importance.htm

performanceIndicator.text: Explain managerial considerations in organizing

questions.question: When a manager is directing, s/he is
questions.explanation: Initiating action. The directing function of management is the process of providing guidance to workers as they work. When a manager is directing, s/he is initiating action to get the work done. Setting goals occurs during the planning function. Identifying resources is part of the planning function. Evaluating feedback is a part of the control function.
questions.source: Juneja, P. (2020). Directing function of management. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from http://www.managementstudyguide.com/directing_function.htm

performanceIndicator.text: Discuss managerial considerations in directing

questions.question: A customer contacts a manager regarding a billing error. After confirming the discrepancy, the manager asks an employee to void the existing invoice and create a new invoice with the correct information. What type of control is the manager using in this situation?
questions.explanation: Feedback. Feedback control occurs after a business activity has been completed. In the situation described, the manager asks an employee to take action (make a correction) based on the feedback that s/he received from a customer. Feedforward is a form of control that bases and establishes procedures by predicting or anticipating activities and their outcomes. Concurrent control involves monitoring business activities as employees perform them. Coercive attitudes involve using aggressive behavior or bullying to get another person to do something.
questions.source: Cromwell, J. (2020). How feedback control impacts the four functions of management in your selected organization. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://smallbusiness.chron.com/feedback-control-impacts-four-functions-management-selected-organization-37663.html#:~:text=Feedback%20control%20is%20a%20process%20that%20managers%20can%20use%20to,to%20what%20was%20actually%20produced.

performanceIndicator.text: Describe the nature of managerial control (control process, types of control, what is controlled)

questions.question: Company executives decided to add a new product line to the company's mix. The company would benefit from
questions.explanation: Change management. Change management is a structured process used to ensure that changes are successfully made and have lasting impact. Change management would be beneficial to a company that is adding a new product line. There is no indication that the company needs to hire new employees, adjust its budget, or undergo ethics training.
questions.source: Prosci. (n.d.). What is change management and how does it work? Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.prosci.com/resources/articles/the-what-why-and-how-of-change-management

performanceIndicator.text: Explain the nature of change management

questions.question: Andy presents his idea for restructuring his company to the board of directors. In which stage of the change-management lifecycle is Andy?
questions.explanation: Review and authorize. After the need for a change has been identified, it must be reviewed and approved before it can move forward. Andy is allowing the board of directors to review and authorize the change he wants to implement. Andy has already identified the need for change, and he is not yet in the implementation or close phases of the change-management lifecycle.
questions.source: Battaglino, J. (2018, December 27). Understanding the change management lifecycle model. Retrieved July 17, 2020, from https://www.cherwell.com/library/blog/understanding-the-change-management-lifecycle-model/

performanceIndicator.text: Explain the change-management lifecycle

questions.question: A business that looks for ways to turn a risk into a strategic advantage would be considered an organization that is
questions.explanation: Risk-seeking. A business that looks for ways to turn a risk into a strategic advantage is actively seeking or taking a risk. A risk-tolerant or risk-accepting organization accepts necessary risks, but it does not actively seek risk. A risk-averse organization attempts to avoid risk as much as possible.
questions.source: LAP-SM-075—Prepare for the Worst; Expect the Best (Nature of Risk Management)

performanceIndicator.text: Explain the nature of risk management
